details: Bitcoin's price has fallen below the $80,000 mark amidst broader market caution and anticipation of the upcoming Federal Reserve decision. This price movement reflects investor jitters influenced by macroeconomic factors like oil prices and potential interest rate adjustments. Several sources indicate significant liquidations of long positions have occurred as Bitcoin struggled to hold key support levels.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $80K Ahead of Fed Decision

details: Ethereum has experienced its largest exchange withdrawal in four months, with October's spot ETF losses surpassing $1 billion. Sentiment in Ethereum derivatives has shifted to negative territory, and nearly $50 million in ETH liquidations were recorded in the past 24 hours, pushing the price below $2,300 USDT.
title: Ethereum Sees Major ETF Losses and Negative Derivative Sentiment

details: The altcoin market is showing a mixed performance. While many altcoins have depreciated due to a general risk-off sentiment and Bitcoin's decline, some projects have seen gains. Quant (QNT) surged by 7.16% driven by institutional partnership announcements, and Uniswap (UNI) rose 4.2% following protocol upgrades and increased adoption.
title: Mixed Performance for Altcoins Amidst Market Uncertainty

details: XRP Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have demonstrated a resumption of their winning streak, indicating a positive trend in investor interest for the cryptocurrency. This performance stands in contrast to Solana (SOL) funds, which have remained in the red, highlighting diverging investor sentiment between the two assets.
title: XRP ETFs Continue Winning Streak, Solana Funds Lag
